description:
List the workspace's knowledge documents, newest first, with their
        status, size and piece count. Returns ``items`` and ``next_cursor``.

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

name: list_knowledge_documents

KnowledgeDocumentResponse.description: One knowledge base document and how far its reading got.

error.description: Why the document failed, in plain words. Null otherwise.
error.title: Error

piece_count.description: Searchable pieces made from the file (0 until ready).
piece_count.title: Piece Count

status.description: `pending`: waiting to be read. `processing`: being read and indexed. `ready`: agents answer from it. `failed`: see `error`.
status.title: Status

KnowledgeDocumentResponse.title: KnowledgeDocumentResponse

items.description: Documents in this page, newest first.
items.title: Items

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null when there are no more results.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

title: List knowledge documents
